<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1960572_training.TrainingHubUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Server-side utilities for TrainingHub business logic, record producer filters, and relationship validations.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>TrainingHubUtils</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var TrainingHubUtils = Class.create();
TrainingHubUtils.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    getAvailableSchedules: function(courseId) {
        var validSchedules = [];

        // Se o usuário ainda não escolheu um curso, retorna uma lista vazia
        if (!courseId) {
            return "sys_idIN"; 
        }

		// Se o curso mudar, limpa o schedule para forçar o usuário a escolher um novo
		// Isso evita que ele envie o formulário com um schedule que não pertence ao curso
		if (newValue != oldValue) {
			g_form.setValue('schedule', '');
		}

        var grSchedule = new GlideRecord("x_1960572_training_schedule");
        
        // Regra 1: Filtrar pelo Curso selecionado
        grSchedule.addQuery("course", courseId);
        
        // Regra 2: A data deve ser pelo menos 1 dia no futuro
        // Pega a data de amanhã como limite mínimo
        grSchedule.addEncodedQuery("date>=javascript:gs.daysAgoStart(-1)");
        
        grSchedule.query();

        while (grSchedule.next()) {
            var maxSeats = parseInt(grSchedule.getValue("max_seats"), 10) || 0;
            var occupiedSeats = parseInt(grSchedule.getValue("occupied_seats"), 10) || 0;

            // Regra 3: Só adiciona na lista se ainda houver vaga
            if (occupiedSeats < maxSeats) {
                validSchedules.push(grSchedule.getUniqueValue());
            }
        }

        // Retorna a string no formato esperado pelo Reference Qualifier
        return "sys_idIN" + validSchedules.join(",");
    },

    type: 'TrainingUtils'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-05-11 21:27:25</sys_created_on><sys_id>39b3cee983b403107bfa9470ceaad38d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>TrainingHubUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Training Hub" source="x_1960572_training">0cd3742183f003107bfa9470ceaad360</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Training Hub">0cd3742183f003107bfa9470ceaad360</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_39b3cee983b403107bfa9470ceaad38d</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-05-11 21:39:15</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
